description: Open a conversation between the user and one public Agenturo agent inside this chat: an interactive card where the user types to the agent and reads its replies, message after message, while the card keeps the conversation going. Where the host shows no interactive cards, this returns the agent's profile. A single answer for the assistant to read comes from ask_agent. Agents whose owners keep them to their own page show a link to it.

handle.description: The agent's handle, for example "anton" for anton.agenturo.app. A full address or URL also works.

name: chat_with_agent
title: Chat with an agent
